purpose: Evidence-based biological target prioritisation rubric for Bipolaris sorokiniana targets, strictly separating experimentally demonstrated evidence, curated database homology, genomic conservation, and verification confidence, while reporting RNA-seq expression as a separate uncombined variable.

audit_findings: Original M05 took max RPKM across all sample columns including mock/non-inoculated/early root samples (1A, 2A, 2B, 3A, 4A) containing only 1,921-3,808 total mapped fungal reads over 148-213 genes.
In that dataset, CsSp1 inplanta_max_rpkm = 1438.44 arose from 1 single raw read in 3A_I on a 322-nt transcript, and CsSTE11 87.63 RPKM arose from 1 single raw read in 2B_III.

Across well-sequenced in-planta samples (3B, 4B, 5B; 107,929-578,376 fungal reads, >8,200 expressed genes), target RPKMs are right-skewed (3B/4B/5B means: CsSp1=79.30, CsFUS3=62.53, CsSTE11=22.12, CsPKS1=13.19) and cover only ND90Pr barley root infection rather than wheat spot blotch.
Arbitrary normalization by 150.0 lacks statistical justification across skewed fungal RPKMs (genome 99th percentile >700 RPKM, max >21,900 RPKM).
expression_exclusion_rationale.decision: Exclude RNA-seq expression from BOTH the biological target composite score and M09 candidate composite score; retain raw mapped read counts, filtered 3B/4B/5B in-planta RPKM, axenic RPKM, fold-induction, and empirical GSE130517 transcriptome percentile rank as explicit separate evidence columns.

rubric.3: Direct targeted gene knockout/disruption in B. sorokiniana demonstrating loss or statistically significant attenuation of host plant pathogenicity
rubric.2: Direct B. sorokiniana silencing/perturbation showing developmental defect linked to infection structures without direct virulence assay confirmation
rubric.1: Direct B. sorokiniana perturbation (e.g., hairpin RNAi) affecting secondary trait (melanin/pigmentation) with unaffected pathogenicity documented in PHI-base
rubric.0: No direct B. sorokiniana functional perturbation reported

rubric.plus_1_phibase_virulence: +1 if PHI-base v4.19 DIAMOND hit (E < 1e-5) explicitly carries 'loss_of_pathogenicity' or 'reduced_virulence' phenotype (0 if unaffected_pathogenicity or absent)
rubric.plus_1_deg_essential: +1 if DEG essential-gene database DIAMOND hit detected (E < 1e-5) in M05 output
rubric.plus_1_interpro_domains: +1 if >= 1 annotated functional domain present in M05 InterProScan/REST output

rubric.plus_1_refseq_model: +1 if mapped to intact RefSeq GCF_000338995.1 gene model (0 internal stops, verified CDS translation matching protein.faa)
rubric.plus_1_independent_accession_or_curated_: +1 if backed by an independent GenBank nuccore gene record (HQ830033.1) or curated named gene/PHI-base B. sorokiniana/maydis entry (0 for unnamed RefSeq locus resolved solely via primers)
rubric.plus_1_published_primer_or_full_clone: +1 if >=3 published experimental primers align across locus/CDS (or 100% full-length cloned sequence match HQ830033.1)
rubric.plus_1_protein_family_congruence: +1 if UniProt + InterPro family domains independently match published biochemical class

biological_vs_dsrna_rule: Absence of a clean dsRNA candidate reflects sequence conservation with non-targets or short CDS constraints, NOT low biological pathogenicity importance.
